description: This file is the entry point for a React.js frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, an application stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' inside a StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components inside a DOM element.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the specified root.
